text:
In the experiment shown, the bell is heard ringing. The air is gradually pumped out of the jar. No
change is made to the ringing bell.
air pump
rubber bands
bell
glass jar
After a few minutes the bell can no longer be heard.
Why is this?
A
The amplitude of vibration of the bell decreases.
B
The frequency of vibration of the bell increases.
C
The sound waves from the bell become transverse.
D
The sound waves need a medium to travel through.

options.label: A
options.text: The amplitude of vibration of the bell decreases.

options.label: B
options.text: The frequency of vibration of the bell increases.

options.label: C
options.text: The sound waves from the bell become transverse.

options.label: D
options.text: The sound waves need a medium to travel through.
